outline.description: Lists the definitions a file declares, each with its line range and the line IDs that edit it. The first look at an unfamiliar file.

inspect.description: Inspects code structure and finds target lines in source files using Tree-sitter.

view.description: Retrieve file lines along with persistent Line IDs. Set only_ids to true to retrieve only IDs and line numbers, excluding text contents.

edit.description: Apply edits transactionally to a file. Answers with the lines it changed, each as [id, line number], so a following edit needs no second read.

create.description: Create a new file and initialize its editing session. Answers with its metadata, and with each line as [id, line number] when asked.
